title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Between Lights and Wind

lines.l: Burning, everyone's rushing but who's returning?
I seek peace in scattered phrases
That no one ever tried embracing
Between lights and wind
I invent a feeling from within
No name, no time, no frame
But it keeps me burning bright again
Between lights and wind
I dance beyond regret and sin
If you find me, don't hold tight
On the echo of the changing light
I left behind the noise and chatter
A voice that's void of love or matter
Now I listen to the real beat
Guiding me through mysteries, heat
No more maps, no borderlines
Just impulses and new designs
My voice is a rising wave
Crashing into life, brave
Between lights and wind
I invent a feeling from within
No name, no time, no frame
But it keeps me burning bright again
Between lights and wind
I dance beyond regret and sin
If you find me, don't hold tight
I'm the echo of a changing light
And if tomorrow never comes
I'll still be dancing through the drums
Cause every honest pulse I feel
Is already something real
Between lights and wind
I don't need sorrow to begin
Just a rhythm that ignites
And carries me
Beyond the night
You don't arrive, you unfold
